headline.en: Flick has used three left-backs in two Liga games
headline.es: Flick ha usado tres laterales zurdos en dos partidos

summary.en: Xavi Espart started at Elche and mixed the Athletic match between the flank and midfield. Joao Cancelo came on late. Alejandro Balde is in the squad and has not started. Flick has to name one of them against Rayo.
summary.es: Espart salio en Elche. Cancelo entro tarde. Balde no ha sido titular. El Rayo obliga a elegir.

body.en:
Flick has given Liga minutes to three players on the left of defence. Xavi Espart started at Elche and, against Athletic, moved between the flank and midfield. Joao Cancelo came off the bench. Alejandro Balde trained with the group after saying he would stay, and has not started.

Rayo Vallecano attack the space behind full-backs, which is why the choice for Monday is more than a preference. Espart is the promoted option. Cancelo is the senior option. Balde is the fastest of the three if Flick wants recovery speed. Two matches are not a season hierarchy. They are enough to show Flick is willing to use all three.

headline.en: After Feyenoord, Barcelona go to Galatasaray and PSG in October
headline.es: Despues del Feyenoord, el Barca va a Galatasaray y al PSG en octubre

summary.en: Once Feyenoord is out of the way, Barcelona go to Galatasaray and Paris Saint-Germain in consecutive away weeks, then host Aston Villa and Manchester City. SPORT called that stretch the hard block of the league phase.
summary.es: Despues del Feyenoord: Galatasaray y PSG fuera, Villa y City en casa. SPORT lo marco como el bloque dificil.

body.en:
Feyenoord at Camp Nou on 9 September is the first European night. The harder fixtures sit later. In October Barcelona travel to Galatasaray and then to Paris in consecutive away weeks. Aston Villa visit in November. Manchester City visit in December. SPORT described that run, close to the Clasico dates, as the difficult block of the league phase.

Eric Garcia already misses Feyenoord because of last season's red card. Gavi and Rodri are being managed. Yamal's minutes rose from an hour at Elche to 90 against Athletic. The summer signings exist for those midweeks as much as for Monday night against Rayo. The Liga match does not change the European list. It decides who is available when the list starts.

headline.en: Barcelona are selling academy players who are not in Flick's side
headline.es: El Barca vende canteranos que no estan en el once de Flick

summary.en: MARCA put Toni Fernandez near five million euros to Venezia and Alvaro Cortes at 3.5 million to Antwerp. Other reports keep Fernandez nearer four million with a buy-back. Hector Fort has already left on similar terms.
summary.es: Fernandez cerca de cuatro o cinco millones al Venezia. Cortes 3,5 al Amberes. Fort ya salio igual.

body.en:
Deco is selling players Flick is not picking. Toni Fernandez is close to Venezia. Alvaro Cortes is close to Antwerp. Hector Fort has already gone. MARCA put Fernandez near five million euros. Other desks, including Romano, have kept the figure nearer four million with a buy-back and a share of a later sale.

Those fees are small next to Gordon and Rodri. They help the 1:1 ratio. In the same week Xavi Espart was promoted to the first team. The academy is not being emptied. The players Flick wants are being moved onto the senior list. The ones he will not use are being sold with a clause attached. The fees only help if they land before the next registration date.
